signals.headline: UPMC Agrees to $950,000 DOJ Settlement and 10-Year Moratorium on Gender-Affirming Care for Youth
signals.summary: UPMC announced a deal with the U.S. Department of Justice to settle a federal investigation into gender-affirming care for minors. Under the agreement, UPMC will pay $950,000 to the government and refrain from providing gender-affirming care to transgender patients under the age of 19.

evidence.quote: UPMC will not resume gender-affirming care for transgender patients under the age of 19 in a new deal announced with the U.S. Department of Justice. The health system will also pay the government $950,000 to settle the Trump administration’s investigation into such care.
